method.stage_filter: Only full_compile/full_materialize invoke the frozen dispatcher; all other workloads are outside scope.

metric_definitions.cpu_system_seconds: API worker self rusage, excluding supervisor CPU.
metric_definitions.cpu_user_seconds: API worker self rusage, excluding supervisor CPU.
metric_definitions.end_to_end_seconds: Before Popen through process exit and reading the result bytes; JSON parsing, oracle checks and artifact inspection excluded.
metric_definitions.engine_seconds: Full compile worker phase before artifact publication; overlaps parse_dictionary_seconds and index_seconds.
metric_definitions.execution_seconds: API supervisor boundary, including setup, verified snapshots and publication; excludes outer API parsing/final response writing. Not pure kernel time.
metric_definitions.index_seconds: Full post-parse phase, including deduplication, indexes, ANALYZE/VACUUM and plan/import metadata; not index CPU alone.
metric_definitions.io_read_bytes: Worker block-I/O accounting (ru_inblock * 512), affected by page cache; not logical input bytes.
metric_definitions.io_write_bytes: Worker block-I/O accounting (ru_oublock * 512), not logical artifact size.
metric_definitions.parse_dictionary_seconds: Full compile phase, including SQLite setup, RDF parse/dictionary insertion and rule constants.
metric_definitions.peak_rss_bytes: API budget measurement combining worker RSS/HWM and supervisor RSS; not PSS and not directly comparable to pack compile process RSS.
metric_definitions.peak_scratch_bytes: API sampled private scratch logical bytes (including detected deleted open files on Linux); not total bytes written.
metric_definitions.process_cpu: wait4 command rusage user/system time; reaped-descendant accounting is OS dependent. Do not add worker CPU to these fields.
metric_definitions.process_wait4_peak_rss_bytes: OS wait4 high-water RSS, not aggregate physical memory; Linux can include pre-exec inherited high-water state.
metric_definitions.process_wall_seconds: Before Popen through wait4 completion. Serial command invocation, including startup and supervisor/worker lifecycle.
metric_definitions.query_validate_core_seconds: Unavailable in the public API. Query/SHACL are measured end to end; no inferred core time is reported.
metric_definitions.reasoning_seconds: Full materialization phase including SQLite setup, semi-naive joins, fixpoint and cleanup/ANALYZE/VACUUM.
metric_definitions.supervisor_peak_rss_bytes: Supervisor process high-water RSS, recorded separately; not additive to peak_rss_bytes.

scope: Full compilation and bounded positive-rule materialization only; manifest counts are checked, full fact content requires a separate read-only audit. Not a query/SHACL or arbitrary recursive-closure capacity claim.
scratch_policy: All child TMPDIR paths are inside the isolated work_directory/scratch, on the selected work filesystem.
statistics: Three planned independent builds per stage by default; medians/ranges use verified COMPLETE samples. Failures stop remaining repeats.
